question: Should the named LiteLLM onboarding choice grow its own interactive base-URL prompt and proxy model-discovery step, or should remote LiteLLM users be directed to the existing Custom Provider flow?
rationale: Both paths are technically plausible, but the choice affects provider-owned onboarding UX, credentialed endpoint probing, and the boundary between bundled provider setup and generic custom endpoints.

options.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
options.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive --custom-base-url compatible.

options.title: Route To Custom Provider
options.body: Keep LiteLLM as localhost/default-model setup and update prompts or docs so remote proxy users choose Custom Provider.

options.title: Defer To Dynamic Catalog Work
options.body: Leave this open until the broader credentialed provider catalog and discovery policy is settled in the related dynamic model-discovery issues.

recommendation.title: Add LiteLLM URL Prompt
recommendation.body: Have litellm-api-key ask for or confirm the proxy base URL before model selection while keeping non-interactive --custom-base-url compatible.

likelyOwner.reason: The pluginized LiteLLM onboarding boundary most directly traces to steipete's commit, making this the clearest owner for the provider setup direction choice.
